title: What AI Benchmarks Actually Measure: Adapting Convergent and Discriminant Validity to Interrogate Fifty-Six AI Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through demographic parity differences in classification tasks (DecodingTrust), exact-match accuracy and bias scores on ambiguous social situations (BBQ, CALM), prediction mismatch rates in narratives with male and female protagonists (GenMO), and average discrimination scores across explicit and implicit variants (DiscrimEval).

Evaluated through demographic parity differences in classification tasks (DecodingTrust), exact-match accuracy and bias scores on ambiguous social situations (BBQ, CALM), and average discrimination scores across explicit and implicit prompt variants (DiscrimEval).

Evaluated via the FtDA (Fairness through Difference Awareness) benchmark subset (D1-religion), which measures contextual awareness and the model's ability to appropriately treat groups differently when prompted with religious descriptors.
Evaluated via the FtDA benchmark subset (D2-occupation) which measures difference awareness and contextual awareness in model responses based on occupational categories.
Evaluated using the DecodingTrust Stereotype bias dataset by measuring the average likelihood of the models agreeing or disagreeing with statements containing known stereotypes.
